2609.14514.title: OptoAgent: A Trustworthy Multi-Agent Framework for Opportunistic Vision Micro-Screening in Classroom Environments
2609.14514.paper_summary: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. We present SightSentinel, an architecture that turns a wall display a child already reads from into a recurring screening site. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. A quality agent discards observations taken under bad geometry, poor lighting, or inattention. A longitudinal agent accumulates only the surviving evidence against the child's own baseline, and an orchestrator reports a Vision Concern Score routed through a safety gate whose output range excludes diagnosis, refraction, prescription, and reassurance. The design question is whether many cheap, noisy, well-gated encounters can reach a referral decision that one scheduled test reaches late or misses. We state the formulation, the architecture, a four-stage validation protocol against clinical reference standards, and the conditions under which the approach should be rejected.
2609.14514.paper_summary_zh: 一個視力距離減弱的孩子通常不知道有任何問題。<lb/>孩子們會適應，靠得更近，並且很少報告困難，因此這個問題可能在學校中存活多年，直到有成人注意到。<lb/>學校篩檢解決了部分問題，但它依賴於時間表、工作人員，並且與出現困難的課堂時刻分開。<lb/>智能手機和基於網絡的視力測試擴大了可及性，但每一個測試仍然需要有人啟動。<lb/>我們提出了SightSentinel，一種將孩子已經閱讀的牆面顯示器轉變為定期篩檢站的架構。<lb/>普通的教育內容攜帶短小的標定視力測試標記，八個專門的代理人分工合作。<lb/>感知代理人從每次接觸中恢復觀看距離、識別準確性、接近行為、凝視穩定性、反應延遲和雙眼差異。<lb/>質量代理人會丟棄在不良幾何、光線不足或注意力不集中下進行的觀察。<lb/>一個縱向代理人僅累積針對孩子自身基準的存活證據，而一個協調者報告通過安全閘路由的視力關注分數，其輸出範圍不包括診斷、屈光、處方和安慰。<lb/>設計問題是許多便宜、嘈雜、良好篩選的接觸是否能達到一個預約測試晚些時候或錯過的轉診決定。<lb/>我們陳述了公式、架構、一個針對臨床參考標準的四階段驗證協議，以及應該拒絕該方法的條件。
